preRegistration.text:
# Pre-registration: WASP-11 b (observed by MObs as "HAT-P-10 b"), 2026-09-05 (committed before any frame was examined)

Frames: 93, 07:42:24 to 12:21:23 UT (JD 2461288.8211 to 2461289.0148).
Ephemeris (NEA default, pl_dict): T0 2456933.615316, P 3.72247975 -> epoch 1170, Tmid 2461288.9166 (09:59:56 UT).
Rp/Rs 0.1413 (depth 2.0%), a/Rs 12.3, inc 89.1, V ~11.9. T14 ~2.6 h: ingress ~08:42, egress ~11:18. Coverage: full, ~1 h pre, ~1 h post.
Context: Art Trail's TransitLab reduction of this night carries a 2.4 sigma SNR warning. The star is well inside the MObs floor (V < 13), so if this night is poor the cause is weather or comps, not the target. This run tests which.

Predictions:
- Tmid within +/-5 min of 2461288.9166 (a 2014 T0 propagated 1170 epochs; period uncertainty compounds).
- If the frames show a stable sky (no cloud steps in the per-frame background), the fit converges with an honest bar of 3 min or better and QC is PASS or MARGINAL; I do not predict which, having missed PASS by 0.06 this morning on flatness alone.
- If the sky is unstable, I expect a FAIL or a rejected night, and the record will say so.
- Any printed bar under 0.001 d is a replaced bar (#1401) and gets refit before entering the ledger.
- Coordinates from a plate solve of the FIRST frame (seed frame), drift bounded by solving the last frame; comps that would leave the frame are dropped by hand, #1409 confirms the rest.

## Outcome (appended 2026-09-05 evening, after the reduction)
- QC: PASS 4.24/5.00 (predicted PASS or MARGINAL). Correct.
- Tmid 2461288.9222 +/- 0.0068 (+8.1 min from 2461288.9166): outside the +/-5 min band at face value, 0.8 sigma given the bar.
- Bar: 9.8 min against a predicted 3 min. Missed by ~3x, the second time today (KELT-23A: predicted 1.5-2, got 6.6). The predicted numbers were asserted, not derived. Calibration from the two nights: a MObs full transit at 0.85% residual scatter, 60 s exposures on ~3 min cadence, 2% depth, gives a Tmid bar of 7-10 min. Next pre-registration derives the bar from scatter x cadence / depth or does not state one.
- Replaced-bar check: clean. Seed: frame 1, confirmed. Comps: brightest field star dropped by hand (leaves chip after the 09:31 step); six kept, all in-frame across the full shift range.

parameters.Fit parameter point estimate: Best-fit likelihood point; uncertainties are posterior spread.
parameters.Pre-UltraNest LM boundary scout note: LM solution and covariance envelope were interior after 4 iteration(s).
parameters.Out-of-transit baseline parameter-fit no: Used a0 and a2 from the previous fast UltraNest fit for the full-resolution final run.
parameters.Out-of-transit baseline detrending note: only 11 pre-ingress and 16 post-egress out-of-transit point(s) were available; need more than 12 on each side to fit a linear baseline.
parameters.Sparse posterior live-point extension no: Applied full-resolution selected comparison-star final UltraNest run (200->1200 minimum live points) with fixed a0/a2 from the previous fast UltraNest fit.
parameters.Final residual rejection note: No residual outliers exceeded 3.0 sigma from the iterated median residual (0.0514%, stdev=0.8475%).
parameters.Uncertainty interpretation note: The primary Rp/R* and radius-ratio area-depth uncertainties use model+red-noise when available. The red-noise uncertainty inflates the data-fit standard error by a residual time-binning beta factor before combining it with the model posterior. The flux baseline red-noise uncertainty is the out-of-transit baseline component used for the final-plot baseline band; the transit-depth red-noise uncertainty already includes both the in-transit and baseline terms. The same residual time-binning beta factor is applied to the posterior uncertainties for Tmid, a/Rs, inclination, and impact parameter when reporting their primary model+red-noise uncertainties. The flux-scatter equivalent is also shown as a diagnostic of the full residual scatter around the model.
